The '''Bormter system''' was a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bormter]].<ref name="Galaxy Dragon">{{DragonCite|200|The Galaxy Dragon and crew|The ''Galaxy Dragon'' and crew}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Publication information===
The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] containing Bormter was first introduced as the Svekk system in "[[The Galaxy Dragon and crew|The ''Galaxy Dragon'' and crew]]," an article written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and published in the [[Dragon Magazine 200|200th issue]] of [[Dragon (magazine)|''Dragon Magazine'']] in [[December]] [[1993]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" /> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the "Bormter" system in grid square H-14.<ref name="TEA" /> The book's co-author [[Jason Fry]] has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star/Legends|star]] systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of the planet Bormter to be canonical with respect to the Legends continuity.<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref>

===The ''Galaxy Dragon'' and crew===
{{Unlicensedstart}}
The Svekk system lay within one of the frontier areas of Wild Space. It contained at least five planets, with Bormter, the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptiloid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] known as [[Bormterran]]s, occupying the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position.<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" />

Shortly after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Delurin]] declared himself [[Warlord of Wild Space]] and used the prototype [[Dragon-class Heavy Cruiser|''Dragon''-class Heavy Cruiser]] ''[[Galaxy Dragon]]'' to conquer Bormter. Delurin subsequently established a power base on the planet for an [[Delurin's empire|empire]] that he carved out in Wild Space.<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" />
{{Unlicensedend}}
